title: The micro always predicts at least as well

statements.text: If the macro distribution is required to come from coarse-graining the micro one, the complete microstate always predicts the future at least as well as any macro approximation, since the macrostate can be computed from it.

sources.quote: knowing the complete initial microstate of a system always gives you at least as much power to predict the system’s future as knowing a macroscopic approximation to that state
